purpose: Define `#CAL` as the reserved root for canonical calendar/time-scheduling data and operations, without equating scheduled time with automatic execution authority.

topics.name: #CAL Calendar Root
topics.purpose: Define `#CAL` as the reserved root for canonical calendar/time-scheduling data and operations, without equating scheduled time with automatic execution authority.

semantics.owner_rule: #CAL resolves to explicit calendar/scheduling identities and operations.
semantics.entry_rule: Calendar entries/events have explicit identities, time semantics and owning source/context.
semantics.time_rule: Date/time/timezone semantics are explicit where machine-significant.
semantics.trigger_rule: A scheduled time may produce an Event/Trigger condition only through explicit automation binding.
semantics.execution_rule: Calendar occurrence alone does not directly execute arbitrary operation.
semantics.projection_rule: Agenda/day/week/month views are projections of calendar semantics.
semantics.authority_rule: Calendar visibility or event ownership does not automatically grant target-operation authority.

invariants.rule: Each reserved runtime root resolves to one explicit semantic owner/family; the root itself never creates semantic ownership or runtime authority.

hard_gates.condition: calendar time directly executes arbitrary operation without explicit Trigger/Runner binding
timezone omitted where required for deterministic machine scheduling
calendar UI ordering becomes execution order
calendar entry identity inferred solely from display text

references.purpose: Scheduled occurrences may emit explicit Events.
Time conditions trigger work only through explicit Trigger bindings.
